Headline: Closure - Avon House School, London
Info: Avon House School in Woodford Green has been placed into administration and will permanently close at the end of the 2025-26 academic year.

Headline: Closure - Eddleston Primary School (State), Scottish Borders
Info: The Scottish Government has approved the permanent closure of Eddleston Primary School, which had been mothballed since 2022 due to low pupil numbers, following a consultation by Scottish Borders Council.

Headline: Potential Closure - Soho Parish Primary School (State), London
Info: Following the abandonment of a proposed merger with All Souls Primary due to falling pupil numbers, a community takeover bid has been launched to save Soho Parish Primary School from potential closure.

Headline: Closure - Wraxall CofE Primary School (State), North Somerset
Info: Wraxall CofE Primary School has officially closed after 225 years due to a sustained decline in pupil numbers, with all remaining students transitioning to new schools ahead of September.
